headline: عندما ينجز المساعد الذكي نصف العمل ولا يكمل المهمة: ماذا كشف اختبار من 108 مهام طويلة؟
reviewer: AI editorial review (not a human reader test)
summary: اختبرت الدراسة 108 مهام حاسوبية طويلة. حقق أفضل إعداد 54.8% من التقدم الجزئي، لكنه أكمل العمل كاملاً في 20.6% فقط؛ وعند أطول 17 مهمة لم يكتمل أي منها.
mobile_evidence: GitHub Actions Arabic editorial gate run 40743663973 rendered actual Chromium mobile widths and completed successfully.

source_evidence.claim: 108 long-horizon tasks, 31 self-hosted services, seven domains and 21 subcategories
Leading configuration: 20.6% strict completion and 54.8% partial credit at 500 steps
source_evidence.assessment: Rounded aggregate scores; no integer numerator is published

source_evidence.claim: Longest human-time bin: 0/17 completed and 17/17 not completed for each listed setup
source_evidence.assessment: Exact result within this selected bin, not general accuracy

source_evidence.claim: 306-practitioner survey, 86 deployment respondents, and 15/20 teams without formal benchmarks
source_evidence.assessment: Independent side context; self-reported practices, not a rerun of OSWorld

decision: PASS after actual mobile Chromium, repository gates, GitHub Pages deployment and bilingual live verification.
terminology_evidence: Computer-use agent, strict completion, partial credit, long horizon, hidden state, dynamic environment and model-based evaluation are defined.
language_evidence: Problem-first Arabic passed a 20–30 second comprehension simulation; exact numerator/denominator is supplied where source data permit, and rounded equivalents are labelled.
